name: @softglass/root
description: Open soft-glass design system for Next.js — 4 visual languages, shadcn-style ownership.

scripts.dev: npm run build:ui && npm run dev -w @softglass/web
scripts.build: npm run build:ui && npm run build -w @softglass/web
scripts.pack:check: npm run pack:check -w @softglass/tokens && npm run pack:check -w @softglass/ui
scripts.registry:validate: npm run registry:generate && npx --yes shadcn@latest registry validate ./registry.json
scripts.registry:build: npm run registry:generate && npx --yes shadcn@latest build ./registry.json -o apps/web/public/r
